identity.title: Laboratory spectroscopic study of the <SUP>15</SUP>N isotopomers of cyanamide, H<SUB>2</SUB>NCN, and a search for them toward IRAS 16293-2422 B

paper_type_evidence.quote: We used the ALMA PILS data to search for the $^{15}$N isotopomers of cyanamide.

coordinates.value: RA 16h32m22.58s, Dec -24d28m32.8s (J2000, continuum peak of source B; analysis position offset 0.5" from it)

evidence.quote: ($\alpha_{\rm J2000} =16^{\rm h}32^{\rm m}22.58s$, $\delta_{\rm J2000} = -24\ensuremath{^\circ}28\ensuremath{'}32.8\ensuremath{''}$)

question.value: Determine accurate spectroscopic parameters of 15N isotopomers of cyanamide from laboratory spectra and search for them in the ALMA PILS data toward IRAS 16293-2422 B

evidence.quote: We wanted to determine spectroscopic parameters of the $^{15}$N isotopomers of cyanamide that are accurate enough for predictions well into the submillimeter region and to search for them in the PILS data.
(project-id: 2013.1.00278.S, PI: Jes K. Jørgensen
carried out in band 7 of ALMA and covering the spectral range 329.15$-$362.90 GHz at 0.244 MHz resolution
7$-$10 mJy beam$^{-1}$ channel$^{-1}$ or 4$-$5 mJy beam$^{-1}$ km s$^{-1}$

provided.value: Rotational spectra of cyanamide isotopologs, 192-507 GHz

evidence.loc: Laboratory spectroscopic details and observed lines
evidence.quote: to cover frequencies between 192 and 507 GHz

what.value: Earlier 15N and 13C isotopolog line lists (135-176 GHz etc.) used in fits

evidence.quote: The line lists of the $^{15}$N isotopomers covered 135$-$176 GHz ($J'' = 6$ to 8)

what.value: Main isotopolog H2NCN line list used for reanalysis

evidence.quote: Our reanalysis of H$_2$NCN data started with the line list from (cite: H2_HD_D2NCN_rot_2013).

what.value: H2N13CN column density 7e13 cm-2 and model parameters

evidence.quote: A column density of $7 \times 10^{13}$ cm$^{-2}$ was obtained for the H$_2$N$^{13}$CN isotopolog.

what.value: PILS survey data and details, observed spectra

evidence.quote: Details of the survey have been presented by (cite: PILS_2016).

evidence.quote: Using the same position, $T_{\rm ex}$, source size, and $FWHM$ as for H$_2$NCN

method.value: Fit of rotational spectra with SPCAT/SPFIT using reduced axis system Hamiltonian, Watson S reduction

evidence.quote: We used Pickett’s SPCAT and SPFIT programs (cite: spfit_1991) to predict and fit rotational spectra of the minor isotopic species of cyanamide

key_parameters.value: Uncertainties 20-100 kHz; higher-order parameters scaled from main isotopolog

evidence.loc: Laboratory spectroscopic details and observed lines
evidence.quote: The uncertainties ranged from 20 kHz for isolated lines with symmetric line shape and good signal-to-noise ratio to 100 kHz.

fitting.value: Parameters released stepwise until fit no longer improved

evidence.quote: parameters of higher order were released until the qualities of the fits no longer significantly improved

method.value: LTE modeling of emission lines at offset position to search for 15N isotopomers

evidence.quote: The emission lines were modeled under the assumption of local thermodynamic equilibrium

key_parameters.value: Tex = 300 K, source size 0.5", FWHM 1 km/s

evidence.quote: with an excitation temperature $T_{\rm ex} = 300$ K, a source size of 0.5$\ensuremath{''}$, and a full line width at half maximum (*FWHM*) of 1 km s$^{-1}$

validation.value: Checked that lines were not due to other identified species and no expected line was missing

evidence.quote: We carefully checked that the two potential lines of H$_2^{15}$NCN were not due to any other species already identified toward this source
We used Pickett’s SPCAT and SPFIT programs (cite: spfit_1991) to predict and fit rotational spectra
we obtain a good model for a column density of $6 \times 10^{13}$ cm$^{-2}$
A 3$\sigma$ upper limit of $3 \times 10^{13}$ cm$^{-2}$ is derived for H$_2$NC$^{15}$N.
$^{14}$N/$^{15}$N ratios of $\gtrsim$80 for H$_2^{15}$NCN and $\gtrsim$160 for H$_2$NC$^{15}$N

findings_qualitative.value: Neither 15N isotopomer is unambiguously detected; two clean lines tentatively assigned to H2(15)NCN

evidence.quote: Two relatively clean lines can be tentatively assigned to H$_2^{15}$NCN.

claims.hypothesis: Can 15N cyanamide isotopomers be detected in PILS with new line lists?
claims.experiment: Lab spectroscopy then LTE modeling of PILS data toward source B
claims.result: Two possible H2(15)NCN lines, none for H2NC(15)N; limits 14N/15N >=80 and >=160
claims.finding: No secure detection; more sensitive observations needed

evidence.quote: more transitions need to be detected to claim a secure detection.

limitations_admitted.value: Line-rich spectra, blending; more transitions needed

evidence.quote: As the spectra of IRAS 16293$-$2422 are very line-rich, more transitions need to be detected to claim a secure detection.

referee_caveats_inferred: No fit uncertainty on the column density
Tex and source size fixed to those of the 13C species
No quantitative detection significance for the two lines

data_public_as_stated.value: Line lists deposited at CDS and CDMS; PILS ALMA project code given

evidence.quote: Files containing the experimental lines or parameters along with auxiliary files are available in the data section of the CDMS

reproducibility.estimated_data_volume_inferred: Large (PILS Band 7 full survey, hundreds of GB)
reproducibility.score_reason: Lab fits are reproducible with the deposited line lists; the astronomical part lacks code and calibration details.
reproducibility.rediscovery_reason: The ALMA part is a minor, qualitative search with few numeric results.
